# Council agendas — synthetic fixture for testing

agenda_diplomatic_corps = {
	name = agenda_diplomatic_corps
	effect = {
		country_border_friction_mult = -0.20
	}
	monthly_progress = {
		base = 2
	}
	on_agenda_finished = {
		add_modifier = { modifier = diplomatic_corps_modifier }
	}
	ai_weight = { weight = 1 }
}
